content.text: /ext:medcp Among drugs linked to reduced gastric acidity, which are most often followed by C. difficile codes within 5 years?
I’ll query the OMOP drug and condition tables, grouping acid-suppressing drug exposures by ingredient and counting patients with a subsequent C. difficile diagnosis within 5 years.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id IN ('Drug','Condition')
  AND (
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%omeprazole%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%esomeprazole%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%rabeprazole%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dexlansoprazole%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%famotidine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ranitidine%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cimetidine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nizatidine%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%clostridioides difficile%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%clostridium difficile%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%c. difficile%'
  )
ORDER BY domain_id, concept_class_id, concept_name
LIMIT 200;

I’ll use standard ingredient concepts plus descendants, then count distinct exposed patients whose first later C. difficile condition code occurs within 5 years.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Drug'
  AND vocabulary_id='RxNorm'
  AND concept_class_id='Ingredient'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN (
    'omeprazole','pantoprazole','lansoprazole','esomeprazole','rabeprazole','dexlansoprazole',
    'famotidine','ranitidine','cimetidine','nizatidine'
  )
ORDER BY concept_name;

WITH acid_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, LOWER(concept_name) AS ingredient_name
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
      AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
      AND standard_concept = 'S'
      AND LOWER(concept_name) IN (
        'omeprazole','pantoprazole','lansoprazole','esomeprazole','rabeprazole','dexlansoprazole',
        'famotidine','ranitidine','cimetidine','nizatidine'
      )
), ingredient_drugs AS (
    SELECT ai.ingredient_concept_id, ai.ingredient_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM acid_ingredients ai
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ai.ingredient_concept_id
), first_exposure AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, id.ingredient_name, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN ingredient_drugs id
      ON id.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY de.person_id, id.ingredient_name
), cdiff_concepts AS (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (193688, 4307981, 45763575, 37161037, 37312146)
    UNION SELECT 193688
    UNION SELECT 4307981
    UNION SELECT 45763575
    UNION SELECT 37161037
    UNION SELECT 37312146
), cdiff_after AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fe.person_id, fe.ingredient_name
    FROM first_exposure fe
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = fe.person_id
     AND co.condition_start_date > fe.index_date
     AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(year, 5, fe.index_date)
    WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cdiff_concepts)
       OR co.condition_source_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cdiff_concepts)
)
SELECT TOP 20
    fe.ingredient_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exposed_patients,
    COUNT(ca.person_id) AS patients_with_cdiff_within_5y,
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(ca.person_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(8,3)) AS pct_followed_by_cdiff
FROM first_exposure fe
LEFT JOIN cdiff_after ca
  ON ca.person_id = fe.person_id
 AND ca.ingredient_name = fe.ingredient_name
GROUP BY fe.ingredient_name
ORDER BY patients_with_cdiff_within_5y DESC, pct_followed_by_cdiff DESC;

content.text: The broad all-exposure denominator query timed out, so I’ll switch to the rarer event-first formulation: start from C. difficile diagnoses and look back 5 years for acid-reducing drug exposures.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH cdiff_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (193688, 4307981, 45763575, 37161037, 37312146, 37169724, 37169725, 4225690)
    UNION SELECT 193688 UNION SELECT 4307981 UNION SELECT 45763575 UNION SELECT 37161037
    UNION SELECT 37312146 UNION SELECT 37169724 UNION SELECT 37169725 UNION SELECT 4225690
), cdiff AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id, condition_start_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence
    WHERE condition_start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cdiff_concepts)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cdiff_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS cdiff_patients
FROM cdiff;

content.text: I’ll compute the ranking from the C. difficile side: for each C. difficile patient, find acid-reducing drug exposures in the preceding 5 years and count distinct patients per ingredient.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH acid_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, LOWER(concept_name) AS ingredient_name
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
      AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
      AND standard_concept = 'S'
      AND LOWER(concept_name) IN (
        'omeprazole','pantoprazole','lansoprazole','esomeprazole','rabeprazole','dexlansoprazole',
        'famotidine','ranitidine','cimetidine','nizatidine'
      )
), ingredient_drugs AS (
    SELECT ai.ingredient_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM acid_ingredients ai
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ai.ingredient_concept_id
), cdiff_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (193688, 4307981, 45763575, 37161037, 37312146, 37169724, 37169725, 4225690)
    UNION SELECT 193688 UNION SELECT 4307981 UNION SELECT 45763575 UNION SELECT 37161037
    UNION SELECT 37312146 UNION SELECT 37169724 UNION SELECT 37169725 UNION SELECT 4225690
), first_cdiff AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS first_cdiff_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence
    WHERE condition_start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cdiff_concepts)
    GROUP BY person_id
), prior_acid_exposure AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.person_id, id.ingredient_name
    FROM first_cdiff fc
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
      ON de.person_id = fc.person_id
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < fc.first_cdiff_date
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(year, -5, fc.first_cdiff_date)
    JOIN ingredient_drugs id
      ON id.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT ingredient_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS cdiff_patients_with_prior_exposure_within_5y
FROM prior_acid_exposure
GROUP BY ingredient_name
ORDER BY cdiff_patients_with_prior_exposure_within_5y DESC;
